title: IT Manager, Middleware Platforms
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.


The IT Applications Manager is responsible for the operational stability, performance, and continuous improvement of a defined portfolio of business applications. This role leads and develops a small team, partners closely with business and IT stakeholders, and ensures services are delivered in line with agreed SLAs and industry’s best practices. The Manager drives problem management, application lifecycle management, and improvement initiatives while maintaining strong technical understanding, service ownership, and customer focus.


**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Owns support and service performance for assigned portfolio, ensuring incidents, requests, problems, and non‑project changes are delivered reliably against SLAs and KPIs, minimising business impact and improving customer satisfaction.
* Drives operational excellence and stability by analysing support trends, leading problem management and root cause analysis, strengthening knowledge management, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives that reduce recurring issues and increase efficiency.
* Building strong stakeholder relationships, understanding business priorities and application criticality, communicating clearly, and escalating risks appropriately to enable confident business operations.
* Leads and develops a high‑performing team, providing coaching, technical guidance, and accountability while fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous capability growth.
* In collaboration with solution architects, ensures applications lifecycle is managed effectively with solution architects and vendors, and overseeing upgrades, enhancements, regulatory changes, security, and project delivery to align technology outcomes with business strategy.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8\+ years of experience supporting and managing business applications and platforms , preferably in enterprise environments (e.g., Product Lifecycle Management such as PTC Windchill; clinical systems; integration/ middleware platform s such as TIBCO, BizTalk, MOVEit).
* 1\+ year of experience leading a technical or operations team of 5 or more team members , with accountability for team performance, coaching/feedback, and people\-management responsibilities (including hiring/termination decisions and partnering with HR on employee relations, as applicable).
* Extensive knowledge of IT operational procedures and platform management, including defining team operating standards and ensuring required processes are followed.
* Strong understanding of related IT processes and/or equipment, with the ability to optimize processes and tooling across areas of responsibility.
* Ability to define and integrate metrics into projects and operations to demonstrate IT value and service performance.
* Ability to communicate and interact professionally across all organizational levels, escalating issues and risks appropriately.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, matrixed, and continuously evolving environment.
* Ability to provide technical guidance to employees, colleagues, and/or customers.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Demonstrates knowledge of IT best practices. Familiarity with ITIL principles or certification is an advantage.
* Strong interpersonal skills; accountable, committed, and customer\-focused.
* Strong analytical/problem\-solving skills; lead incident and problem management (major incidents, RCA, corrective/preventive actions).
* Proactive and positive; takes ownership to drive issues to resolution.

title: Senior HR Tech Engineer (Workday - Absence, Time Tracking & Payroll)
description:
**ABOUT FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT**

Flutter Entertainment is the world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator **with 15\.9 million Average Monthly Players** worldwide and an annual revenue of **$16\.4 billion** in 2025\. We have a portfolio of iconic brands, including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.


Flutter Entertainment is listed on both the **New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE).** We’re proud to be recognized by **TIME** as one of the **World’s Best Companies 2025** — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  

  

Our ambition is to transform global gaming and betting to deliver long\-term growth and a positive, sustainable future for our sector. Together, we are **Changing the Game** .


**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**

Our office in the heart of Hi\-Tech City, **Hyderabad** serves as **Flutter Entertainment’s Global Capability Center (GCC).** Now home to 1,000\+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data \& Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech \& Analytics.


We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. Our portfolio of **world\-class brands, global scale, and challenger mindset** presents a powerful combination. We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future and the **global and local scale to achieve them.**

**OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE**

Reporting into a product owner the Senior Product Analyst (Payroll, Absence \& Time) will lead on the design, configuration, and optimisation of Workday changes (e.g. technical enhancements) across the P, A \& T area of the Global People Technology suite. The role will support the business to solve problems by assessing needs, understanding requirements, investigating potential solutions, escalating issues as they arise and ensuring the successful launch of new functionality related to a specialist product area.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Specialist in P, A \& T solution design within Workday and associated technologies for change requests and new releases, giving recommendations where appropriate.
* Drive the configuration of P, A \& T changes within Workday and bolt on systems, taking more ownership on certain platforms as required.
* Second line tech support for P, A \& T queries, liaising with the Customer Experience and Centre of Excellence teams to assist with technology related queries.
* Identify initiatives surrounding the continual improvement of Workday’s P, A \& T configuration.
* Support the Product Owners with cross\-functional initiatives and projects across the team as required.
* Support the Product Owners with strategic initiatives and implementation for new Flutter employee populations or technologies.
* Act as specialist regarding the relevant capabilities/limitations and business processes within the Talent Product area.
* Maintain awareness, understanding and knowledge of all functionalities related to P, A \& T.
* Participate in product and project meetings

title: HR Analyst
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai. You may choose to work from home in Mumbai; however, you will be required to travel to our Andheri East office once a week for business requirements, meetings, or company/team events, or on short notice as needed.
We’re looking for a passionate HR analyst with advanced excel skills and excellent comprehension to join us!  

As an HR analyst, you will be the custodian of HR data. You will be responsible for gathering, cleaning, collating and converting data into various accurate reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders within the organization. You will play a pivotal role as the reports and dashboards you create will enable leaders to make informed \& data\-driven decisions that will shape the future of Human Resources at CACTUS! You will report to the Director, HR Operations \& Administration.
Job responsibilities:
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand the problem statement or objective.
* Gather relevant data from various sources, databases, internal systems and combine data from multiple sources to a cohesive dataset using MS Excel.
* Clean the data by removing any duplicates, correcting errors, handling missing values to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Ask the right questions, comprehend and use advanced excel techniques such as pivots, validation automation, formula, macros among others to analyze \& interpret the data.
* Create various reports and dashboards such as headcount \& attrition report, people cost reports, hiring \& ad\-hoc data reports etc.
* Work closely with the Director, HR Operations \& Administration to learn to draw meaningful conclusions from the analysis and summarize key insights \& recommendations.


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelors in any discipline; bachelor’s in engineering or mathematics, statistics is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in using advanced excel techniques.
* Passionate about data with an affinity for numbers and metrics.
* At least 1\-2 years of experience with creating reports from scratch and analyzing HR related data.
* Excellent comprehension skills \& ability to ask the right questions.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication skills \& has a learning mindset.
* Self\-motivated and takes initiative


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, you will have to work on an assessment followed by a virtual interview and lastly an in\-person interview at our Andheri East office.

**Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. title: HR Coordinator
description:
**Who We Are**



Interdependence is the most effective and innovative public relations and integrated marketing solutions firm, powered by proprietary technology to enable brands and their founders and marketing leaders to enhance the quality of their businesses and their lives. We have nearly 100 full\-time team members across the country and are rapidly growing. Interdependence was named "One of Americas Best PR Agencies" by Forbes.



At Interdependence, we have an unwavering commitment to fostering a collaborative and performance\-driven work environment. Team members are encouraged to innovate and share ideas openly and are provided with tremendous opportunities for professional growth.


**The Role**



We are looking for an experienced HR Coordinator to work alongside our HR Director to support the global HR operations across Interdependence and its affiliated companies.



The HR Coordinator will manage key HR processes, including onboarding, employee records, compliance, HR systems, and employee lifecycle coordination globally.



The HR Coordinator will support HR administration for all US and global new hires, including processing onboarding paperwork, coordinating employee documentation, and ensuring a smooth and compliant onboarding experience across regions. This person will maintain accurate and compliant employee records in HiBob, support HR reporting and documentation, and partner cross\-functionally with department leaders to ensure employee data and HR processes are aligned across the business.



The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of HR experience, strong attention to detail, experience supporting global teams, and deep knowledge of US employment laws and HR compliance requirements in the US. They should also be comfortable improving and automating workflows using AI tools such as Claude or similar platforms.


**Responsibilities**


* Support day\-to\-day HR operations and administrative processes across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, transfers, job changes, and employee documentation
* Coordinate and manage onboarding for new hires globally, ensuring a seamless and welcoming experience from offer acceptance through day one
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, organizational data, and documentation in a timely and confidential manner
* Serve as a key point of contact for employee HR\-related questions, escalating issues as needed and ensuring a high level of responsiveness and professionalism
* Support HR compliance and documentation requirements across multiple regions, helping ensure adherence to local labor regulations, internal policies, and best practices
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate HR workflows using AI tools and platforms such as Claude or similar technologies


**Required Qualifications**


* 5–7 years of experience in HR coordination, HR operations, or a related human resources role
* Deep knowledge of U.S. and HR compliance requirements
* Experience supporting global organizations
* Experience using HRIS systems, including maintaining accurate employee records; experience with HiBob is a plus
* Proficiency with AI tools and platforms, including experience using tools such as Claude or similar technologies to streamline work, improve output, and automate processes
* Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Familiarity with HR compliance, documentation requirements, and employment practices across multiple geographies is a plus
* Ability to work U.S. business hours

We offer total rewards that are easily understood, recognize results, enable career mobility, and reflect our commitment to valuing diverse needs in a fast\-moving world. We provide:


* Competitive compensation and benefits
* Work\-life flexibility
* Recognition and rewards
* Development and career opportunities
* A safe and inclusive workplace

title: Sr Compensation Specialist
description:
The Senior Compensation Specialist will play a critical role in delivering centralized, best‑in‑class compensation operations across Honeywell’s global enterprise, with a primary focus on the APAC region. This role serves as the hands‑on compensation operations expert within the HRS Compensation Operations (Comp Ops) function, providing data‑driven support across all businesses, functions, and geographies.


Partnering closely with the Total Rewards Center of Excellence (CoE) and Human Resources, this role ensures the effective execution, governance, and continuous improvement of Honeywell’s compensation programs, systems, and processes. The Senior Compensation Specialist will enable a compensation framework that is performance‑driven, market‑competitive, internally equitable, and compliant with local and global regulatory requirements.


This position requires a strong combination of compensation expertise, analytical capability, systems proficiency, and operational excellence, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for HR and business stakeholders.


  
**YOU MUST HAVE**

Bachelor's Degree.


WE VALUE


* Some human resources experience preferably in a generalist capacity
* Compensation experience in market data and other operations
* Ability to communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders
* Ability to influence at varying levels across the organization
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and navigate in a highly matrixed environment
* Quickly analyzing, incorporating, and applying new information and concepts
* Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn
* Individuals who are self\-motivated and able to work with little supervision, who consistently take the initiative to get things done, do things before being asked by others or forced to by events.

  
**Key Responsibilities**

Compensation Operations \& Program Support


* Serve as the primary compensation operations specialist supporting global businesses and locations, with a strong emphasis on APAC regional requirements.
* Execute and support core compensation processes, including annual compensation planning cycles, salary reviews, job architecture alignment, incentive eligibility, and compensation transactions.
* Act as a trusted operational partner to the Total Rewards CoE and HR, ensuring consistent and accurate application of compensation policies, guidelines, and governance.

Data, Analytics \& Reporting


* Own and deliver compensation analytics, reporting, and insights, including workforce pay analysis and ad hoc requests.
* Ensure high data quality, integrity, and compliance across compensation datasets by proactively identifying issues, trends, and risks.
* Develop clear, meaningful reporting that supports leadership decision‑making and reinforces pay‑for‑performance principles.

Market Data \& Benchmarking


* Support market pricing and survey participation, including job matching, data validation, analysis of survey results, and market range updates.
* Partner with the CoE and HR to interpret market data and assess competitiveness, trends, and regional dynamics—particularly within APAC labor markets.
* Maintain documentation, audit trails, and governance standards related to market data usage.

Systems, Processes \& Governance


* Provide operational support across HR and compensation systems, ensuring accurate configuration, data flows, and downstream impacts.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, streamline, and improve compensation processes, leveraging automation, controls, and best practices.
* Support global compensation projects and transformation initiatives, including system enhancements, regulatory changes, and process redesign.

  
Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

Help design, prototype, and validate high‑power RF products—primarily RF filters and related systems used in semiconductor manufacturing—with a focus on robust electrical design and thermal control. This is a hands‑on role spanning lab testing, schematics/BOMs, and close collaboration with manufacturing.

**What you’ll do**

* Review electrical schematics, drawings, specifications sheet and BOM for functionality and manufacturability.
* Engage in R\&D activities to test new ideas. This involves hands on prototyping and testing.
* Testing with electrical test and measurement tools such as multimeters, LCR meters, impedance, and spectrum analyzers.
* Develop electrical schematic diagrams, drawings, and BOM.
* Provide support to manufacturing engineering team for OMS (operational method sheet) which includes manufacturing process flow diagram, BOM, and work instructions
* Includes hands on wiring and prototyping, working independently or with other team members

**What you’ll bring**

* Strong fundamentals in electrical engineering; practical RF experience.
* Proficiency with test \& measurement gear (multimeter, LCR/impedance, spectrum analyzer).
* Ability to read/create schematics; Autodesk Electrical preferred; 3D modeling exposure a plus.
* Proficiency with MS Office and MS Project.
* Education/Experience by level (per JD): Level I—BS in Mechanical (Manufacturing/Electro‑Mechanical or equivalent); Level II—4\+ yrs; Level III—6\+ yrs; Sr—10\+ yrs. (We can adjust to “Electrical Engineering or related” if desired.)

**Why you’ll love it here**

Therm\-x of California stands out as a premier destination for professionals passionate about precision engineering, advanced manufacturing, and impactful innovation. With its headquarters in Hayward, CA, Therm\-x has built a reputation since 1983 as a leader in thermal solutions—serving high\-tech industries through vertically integrated capabilities that span thermal design and testing, CNC machining, metal joining, sheet metal fabrication, and electro\-mechanical assembly. title: ISO 27001 Audit Intern
description:
**Internship Duration:** 3 Months (Onsite)

**Location:** Onsite

**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow security policies.
* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
* Conduct yourself professionally with clients and internal teams.

**Potential Full\-Time Conversion (Post Internship)**

Subject to **performance**, selected interns may be considered for **conversion to a full\-time position** at the end of the 3\-month internship.

title: IP Admin Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

 **Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

  

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

  

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

 **What will you be doing in this role?**

  

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

 **About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

 **Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (9 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

description:
**ABOUT BLOSTEM**

Blostem is a Startup India\-registered fintech infrastructure company founded in October 2021, backed by leading investors including Rainmatter (Zerodha), MobiKwik, AC Ventures, GrowX, and Blue Lotus.

We provide a unified banking SDK and API that enables fintechs and financial institutions across India to embed financial products — such as Fixed Deposits, Recurring Deposits, and more directly into their apps without building backend infrastructure from scratch.

Our platform drastically reduces time\-to\-market: partners can go live in 7 days versus the traditional 9–12 months per bank integration. We handle regulatory compliance, bank onboarding, and reconciliation so our partners can focus entirely on user experience.

We serve 30\+ platforms including MobiKwik, Upstox, Jupiter, and Zerodha, with partnerships across 10\+ banks and NBFCs. We are ISO 27001 certified and operate as a Technical Service Provider under RBI and NPCI regulations with AES\-256 encryption for data protection.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a highly creative and trend\-savvy Content Creator Intern who loves storytelling, short\-form content, and building engaging brand narratives across digital platforms.

If you are someone who constantly observes trends on LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube, understands hooks and virality, and enjoys turning ideas into impactful content — this role is for you. You will have real creative ownership and the freedom to experiment, not just execute tasks.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Social Media Content: Create engaging, high\-quality content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and other social platforms tailored to each channel's audience and format.
* Short\-Form \& Video Content: Develop short\-form scripts, reel concepts, and storyboards; assist in ideation and execution of video\-first content campaigns.
* Copywriting: Write compelling captions, hooks, and storytelling\-driven posts that drive engagement and reflect Blostem's brand voice.
* Carousel \& Visual Content: Design and script carousel posts in collaboration with the design team to communicate complex fintech ideas simply and visually.
* Trend Research: Actively research platform trends, viral content formats, and competitor activity to continuously suggest fresh, innovative content ideas.
* Brand Consistency: Help build and maintain a strong, consistent brand voice across all digital touchpoints.
* Campaign Support: Assist in planning and executing end\-to\-end content campaigns tied to product launches, partnerships, and seasonal moments.
* Analytics \& Optimisation: Track engagement metrics across platforms and use data insights to optimise content performance over time.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Must\-Have**

* Pursuing or recently completed graduation in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Media, or a related field (open to other disciplines with strong content skills).
* Strong writing and storytelling skills with the ability to craft content that resonates across different audiences and platforms.
* Creative thinking with a sharp eye for trends — someone who instinctively knows what will and won't work on social media.
* Basic understanding of social media algorithms and what drives reach, engagement, and virality.
* Familiarity with tools like Canva, CapCut, Notion, or similar content creation and productivity tools.
* Self\-driven and proactive mindset; able to take a brief and run with it independently.

**Bonus Points If You**

* Have managed a personal or brand social media page with measurable growth or engagement results.
* Understand the fintech, SaaS, or startup ecosystem and can communicate technical concepts in simple, accessible language.
* Have basic video editing skills and are comfortable being on camera (preferred but not required).
* Can generate original content ideas independently and pitch them with clear rationale.
* Have experience with LinkedIn content creation specifically, given Blostem's B2B focus.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**

* Real hands\-on exposure to building a startup brand from the ground up — not just internship busywork.
* Creative freedom to experiment with content formats, ideas, and strategies with direct impact on brand visibility.
* Direct mentorship from the marketing leadership team who will invest in your growth.
* A strong portfolio of live content — posts, reels, campaigns, and more — that you can showcase.
* Certificate of completion and a strong recommendation letter based on performance.
* Performance\-based Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for a full\-time role.

Bonus: Share 2–3 content pieces you've created (posts, reels, carousels) or a content idea you'd pitch for Blostem's LinkedIn page.

**Department:** Sales

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an energetic and goal\-oriented Field Sales Executive to join our sales team. This is a purely field\-based sales role. The candidate will be responsible for going out, meeting potential clients door\-to\-door, generating leads from the ground, and converting those leads into business. Inbound leads from social media, referrals, and networking are handled by a separate Business Development Executive — this role is solely focused on field sales and on\-ground lead generation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Door\-to\-Door Field Sales**

* Visit potential clients directly in the field across Surat and nearby areas on a daily basis.
* Introduce the company and its products to new prospects through direct, face\-to\-face interactions.
* Build initial rapport with clients and identify genuine business interest.

**Lead Generation from the Field**

* Actively scout for new business opportunities through on\-ground fieldwork.
* Identify and shortlist potential clients who have a need for our products.
* Pass well\-qualified leads to the reporting manager or BDE for further follow\-up and closure.

**Sales Conversion**

* Pitch the product confidently and handle basic objections during field visits.
* Work towards converting visited leads into confirmed business.
* Follow up with interested clients within a reasonable time to keep interest alive.

**Target Achievement**

* Achieve monthly sales targets assigned by the management.
* Submit daily and weekly field visit reports to the reporting manager.
* Maintain a clear record of all prospects visited, their status, and next steps.

**Skills Required**

* Strong communication skills in Gujarati and Hindi (English is an added advantage).
* Confident, approachable, and persuasive in face\-to\-face conversations.
* Ability to handle rejection and stay motivated in a field\-heavy role.
* Self\-disciplined with the ability to plan and execute daily field visits independently.
* Basic understanding of sales techniques and client handling.
* Comfortable using a smartphone for reporting and communication.
* Physically active and willing to travel within Surat and surrounding areas regularly.

**Education**

* Minimum: 12th Pass (HSC or equivalent).
* Preferred: Graduate in any stream (B.Com, BBA, BA, or equivalent).

**Experience**

**Experienced Candidates**

* 1–3 years of experience in the textile industry in a field sales or direct sales role.
* Prior experience of visiting clients directly and closing deals on the field is preferred.
* Knowledge of the Surat textile market and existing client contacts will be a strong advantage.

**Freshers / Career Switchers**

* A strong work ethic and comfort with daily fieldwork is more important than industry background.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed monthly salary with performance\-based incentives on target achievement.
* Clear growth path within the organization based on sales performance.
* Hands\-on training and product knowledge support from experienced team members.
* Direct exposure to the Surat textile market and a strong professional network.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable being in the field every day, enjoys talking to new people, and has the persistence to keep going even when doors don't open immediately. description:
**Job Title: Sales \& Operations Manager (Wellness Industry)**

**Role Overview**

The Sales \& Operations Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end management of clinic operations, driving revenue growth, ensuring high\-quality service delivery, and maintaining operational excellence. This role requires strong leadership, sales acumen, and experience in the wellness/aesthetic industry.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Sales \& Revenue Management**

* Drive overall center profitability and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
* Set realistic sales targets for team members and monitor daily performance.
* Plan and execute center\-level offers, promotions, and revenue\-generating strategies.
* Work closely with sales and category heads to maximize conversions and bookings.
* Ensure optimum utilization of infrastructure, staff, and resources to maximize revenue.

**2\. Operations Management**

* Act as the single point of accountability for overall center operations.
* Ensure smooth functioning across administrative, operational, and technical areas.
* Monitor appointment planning and client flow to enhance efficiency and client experience.
* Maintain liaison between the center and corporate office for smooth coordination.
* Ensure all equipment is functional and center readiness is maintained at all times.

**3\. Client Experience \& Retention**

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through quality service delivery.
* Implement and monitor client retention strategies and follow\-up mechanisms.
* Personally engage with critical, VIP, or dissatisfied clients to resolve concerns.
* Ensure timely resolution of client complaints (within 48 hours at center level / 7 days with corporate support).
* Monitor client progress and coordinate with technical/R\&D teams for improved outcomes.

**4\. SOP Compliance \& Quality Control**

* Ensure strict adherence to SOPs across all services and operations.
* Conduct regular audits and reviews to maintain service quality standards.
* Take corrective actions and coordinate with corporate teams for deviations.
* Monitor documentation, client records, and software entries for accuracy and timeliness.

**5\. Team Management \& Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage center staff to achieve performance goals.
* Assist in recruitment, conduct preliminary interviews, and support onboarding.
* Identify training needs (fresher/refresher/advanced) and coordinate with R\&D.
* Ensure proper induction, on\-the\-job training, and performance tracking.
* Manage staff attrition and maintain optimal manpower levels.

**6\. Marketing \& Business Development**

* Plan and execute in\-house and external events for revenue generation and brand awareness.
* Collaborate with corporate marketing teams on campaigns and promotions.
* Monitor and analyze local marketing initiatives and customer engagement data.
* Drive CRM initiatives and ensure effective follow\-ups on leads and inquiries.

**7\. Administrative \& Compliance Management**

* Monitor center budgets and control operational costs without impacting service quality.
* Oversee inventory management, product usage (FIFO), and stock availability.
* Ensure accurate MIS reporting and timely submission to corporate teams.
* Maintain hygiene, safety, and upkeep of the center as per defined standards.

**8\. Reporting \& Coordination**

* Provide regular updates on sales, operations, and performance to senior management.
* Conduct daily/monthly team meetings and share reports with corporate office.
* Coordinate with zonal heads and corporate teams for operational and strategic support.

**9\. Additional Responsibilities**

* Support pre\-opening activities for new centers (setup, planning, staffing).
* Identify and groom internal talent for leadership roles.
* Handle any additional responsibilities assigned by senior management.

**Key Requirements**

* Proven experience in **Wellness / Aesthetic / Healthcare industry** (mandatory).
* Strong background in **sales and operations management**.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage teams, drive targets, and ensure high customer satisfaction.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, reporting tools, and operational processes.

**Key Focus Areas**

* Revenue growth \& profitability
* Customer satisfaction \& retention
* SOP compliance \& service quality
* Team performance \& development
* Operational efficiency \& cost control

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
The HR Business Partner acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders, aligning people strategy with business objectives to drive performance, culture, and employee experience. This is a people manager role owning the end\-to\-end HR lifecycle for assigned business units—including succession planning, talent development, performance enablement, and change management, while also leading project\-based Employee Engagement programs (e.g., Rewards \& Recognition, Sports, HR Audits) to strengthen culture and compliance. Key Talent Initiatives such as Talent Review, IDP and Succession Planning for building a strong leadership pipeline.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\) Strategic HR Partnership
 



 •Partner with BU leaders to translate business goals into workforce plans, org design, and capability\-building roadmaps.
 



 •Provide data\-driven insights using HR analytics (attrition, headcount, span, productivity, engagement scores) to influence decisions.
 



 •Facilitate change management for org changes, policy updates, and transformation project s.
 



 •Advise on compensation positioning, internal equity, and retention levers in partnership with P\&R \& TA.
 



  





 2\) Talent \& Performance Enablement
 



 •Drive performance cycle execution (goal setting, mid\-year/annual reviews, calibration, development plans).
 



 •Identify critical roles and successors; facilitate talent reviews and development journeys.
 



 •Coach managers on feedback, career development, and team effectiveness.
 



 •Partner with L\&D to deliver targeted learning interventions and leadership programs.
 



  





 3\) Employee Relations \& Policy Governance
 



 •Serve as first point of contact for employee relations matters; conduct fair, well\-documented investigations.
 



 •Advise managers on policy interpretation; ensure consistent and compliant application of HR policies.
 



 •Support disciplinary processes and statutory compliance in partnership with Legal \& GSD4\) Team Management
 



 •Provide direction, coaching, and performance feedback to build a high‑performing, collaborative HR team.
 



 •Prioritize, delegate, and monitor team deliverables to ensure timely, high‑quality execution aligned with business needs.
 



 •Foster an inclusive, trust\-based team culture that encourages continuous learning, ownership, and accountability.
 



 Corporate Projects:
 



 A) Sports \& Wellness Programs
 



 •Design an annual sports and wellness calendar (indoor/outdoor events, fitness conclave).
 



 •Manage vendor partners, budgeting, logistics, and safety protocols.
 



 •Drive participation through targeted communication, and recognition for winners / volunteers.
 



  





 B) Rewards \& Recognition (R\&R)
 



 •Own the R\&R framework (spot, quarterly, annual, peer\-to\-peer, values awards) aligned with culture and business goals.
 



 •Run nomination and governance processes, maintain fairness, transparency, and audit readiness.
 



 •Curate meaningful rewards (monetary, experiences, badges, social recognition on internal platforms).
 



 •Publish dashboards on coverage, distribution equity, and business impact stories.
 



  





 C) HRBP Audit \& Compliance Readiness
 



 •Plan and execute periodic HR audits covering employee lifecycle, documentation, payroll inputs, leaves, statutory compliance, and vendor SLAs.
 



 •Close gaps with corrective and preventive action plans (CAPA) and track to completion.
 



 •Maintain updated SOPs, risk registers, and audit checklists; enable teams via training.
 



 •Coordinate with Internal Audit/Legal/compliance to ensure zero critical observations.
 



  





 D) Culture \& Engagement Projects
 



 •Support in pulse surveys and action planning; co \-create engagement charters with BU leaders.
 



 •Lead onboarding experience improvements and manager enablement sessions.
 



 •Organize flagship culture events (foundation day, festivals, townhalls)
 



  





 E) Stakeholder Management
 



 •Business Unit Heads, Functional Leaders, People Managers
 



 •Centers of Excellence (TA, P\&R, L\&D), Legal, IT, Facilities, Admin
 



 •External vendors for events
 



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 •Bachelor’s degree required; MBA/PG in HR.
 



 •Experience: Exposure to running end\-to\-end engagement programs
 



 •Comfortable with multi\-site or matrix environments.
 



  





 Skills \& Competencies
 



 •Business Acumen \& Data Fluency: Excel/Sheets, HRIS/ HRMS analytics, dashboarding.
 



 •Influencing \& Coaching: Ability to counsel managers and navigate ambiguity.
 



 •Program/Project Management: Planning, budgeting, vendor management, risk control.
 



 •Compliance Know How: Policy interpretation, investigation discipline, audit rigor.
 



 •Communication: Crisp written and verbal communication; executive presentation skills.
 



 •Culture Champion: Empathy, in clusion mindset, and bias awareness.

title: Team Member -Employee Relations- Delhi
description:
**Job Summary**
 The HR \- ER Compliance Manager – Zonal will be responsible for Employee Relations and compliance across assigned branches within the zone for the Gold Loans business. The role ensures adherence to statutory labour laws, company policies, audit requirements, and ethical HR practices. The incumbent must be comfortable with frequent travel to branches for audits, investigations, and compliance monitoring.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**1\. HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure 100% statutory compliance across branches (Shops \& Establishment Act, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, PF, ESI, CLRA, POSH, etc.).
* Conduct periodic HR compliance audits across branches.
* Maintain updated compliance trackers and documentation.
* Coordinate with legal and compliance teams for statutory filings and inspections.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR and labour compliance.


**2\. Employee Relations (ER)**
* Manage employee grievance handling and resolution within defined timelines.
* Conduct disciplinary inquiries and domestic investigations where required.
* Support HRBP in handling misconduct, absenteeism, and performance issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of warning letters, charge sheets, and termination processes.
* Promote a positive employee relations climate across the zone.
* Monitor adherence to code of conduct and ethical standards.
* Partner with Business HR to address Employee issues.
* Oversee background verification and employee documentation.


**3\. POSH \& Workplace Conduct**
* Ensure compliance with POSH regulations across branches.
* Support IC inquiries and conduct awareness sessions.


**4\. Travel \& Field Engagement**
* Conduct regular branch visits across the assigned zone.
* Perform surprise compliance checks and employee engagement meetings.
* Be available for urgent ER matters and statutory inspections.


**Key Skills \& Competencies:**
* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in Employee Relations and disciplinary processes.
* Investigation and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong documentation and audit management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the zone.

title: Manager- Human Resource Business Partner
description:
A career in Human Resources, within Internal Firm Services, will provide you with the opportunity to make a difference at PwC by helping to fully leverage the skills and talents of all our people. You’ll focus on helping the local offices in driving the Firm’s people strategy, creating a unique people experience for each individual, and supporting our Firm wide values by working with the core competencies that measure and drive individual and Firm wide success in the marketplace. Our team helps bridge the relationship between leadership and employees at PwC through Human Resources solutions. You’ll handle issues on operation management, strategic partnership, employee relations and emergency responding.
   

  

 To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose\-led and values\-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.
   

  

 As a Manager, You'll Work As Part Of a Team Of Problem Solvers, Helping To Solve Complex Business Issues From Strategy To Execution. PwC Professional Skills And Responsibilities For This Management Level Include But Are Not Limited To:
   

  

* Develop new skills outside of comfort zone.
* Act to resolve issues which prevent the team working effectively.
* Coach others, recognise their strengths, and encourage them to take ownership of their personal development.
* Analyse complex ideas or proposals and build a range of meaningful recommendations.
* Use multiple sources of information including broader stakeholder views to develop solutions and recommendations.
* Address sub\-standard work or work that does not meet firm's/client's expectations.
* Use data and insights to inform conclusions and support decision\-making.
* Develop a point of view on key global trends, and how they impact clients.
* Manage a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
* Simplify complex messages, highlighting and summarising key points.
* Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.


 The Opportunity
   

  

 When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
   

  

 As part of the Risk and Compliance team you are expected to serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders with a focus on accelerating the development of our people. As a Manager you are expected to supervise, develop, and coach teams, manage client service accounts, and drive assigned client engagement workstreams by supervising teams and independently solving and analyzing complex problems to develop top\-quality deliverables. You are expected to be responsible for collaborating with partners/leaders to identify issues and develop and execute action plans across various areas of our people strategy including diversity, development, performance management, and rewards and recognition.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serving as a trusted advisor to partners and leaders
* Managing client accounts with a focus on strategic planning
* Mentoring and developing junior staff to enhance their skills
* Ensuring project success by maintaining elevated standards
* Motivating and inspiring team members to deliver quality work
* Collaborating with partners to identify and address issues
* Implementing action plans for diversity and development
* Demonstrating leadership and accountability in every task


 What You Must Have
   

  

* High School Diploma
* 4 years of Human Capital or PwC Experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* PHR or SPHR Certification
* Serving as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Collaborating on people strategy including diversity and development
* Leading potential talent and succession planning
* Developing reliable relationships with staff
* Focusing on diversity initiatives with partners/leaders
* Supporting onboarding and offboarding processes
* Applying coaching skills to increase effectiveness

The Manager, HRBP is responsible for planning and executing HR Programs and strategies to support the needs of ILM through collaboration with stakeholders, HR specialist groups and other HR business partners. This role will support a client group within ILM and partner closely with other HRBP’s. * Assists in designing and implementing HR solutions to business strategies, initiatives and challenges
* Partners with the compensation team to lead pay for performance programs including annual merit review, bonus, promotions and out of cycle requests.
* Partner with Talent Management and Training to assess talent capabilities and development needs based on business strategy.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* Experience working with senior executives in an “influence without authority” role
* Ability to perform with a “roll\-up your sleeves” attitude, equally adept at thinking strategically and operationally
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage ambiguity – dealing with issues that do not always have a process or a system in place, and potentially with conflicting priorities and/or perspectives.
* Strong business sense with a keen ability to quickly digest new information.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills.
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to details.
* Ability to gain trust and work effectively across multiple stakeholders.

title: Director, HR Shared Services, APAC

 This role is remote (ideally based in Mumbai / Bangalore) and reports to the Senior Director, HR Shared Services.
   

  

**This role is a key member of the wider HR team, which is committed to building a workplace that fuels growth, for the business and each one of us. We are transforming our HR organization to deliver compelling experiences every day for our associates, leaders and HR team through strategic partnership to** 
**the business, supported by niche expertise in high\-value areas and a service organization that meets associate needs every day. Bring your passion for supporting business growth through its talent and organization and join us in our journey!**
**Your Responsibilities**
* Bring a regional lens to the development of the global HR Shared Services strategy and roadmap, ensuring a strong linkage to the overall enterprise strategy and culture, with a goal to drive exceptional employee experiences and improved operational efficiencies
* Contribute to the development and expansion of the Global Service Catalogue based on regional insights and needs
* Lead your team of regional Tier 1 to Tier 3 Service Partners and Specialists aligned to the Global Service Catalogue and Standard Work
* Lead the implementation and contribute to the continuous improvement of the internal operational enterprise processes in your region to ensure accurate and timely processing of HR requests
* Identify automation/Ai opportunities to drive regional innovation, optimization and agility
* Partner with the Global Process Owners (GPOs) to develop and deploy the regional process harmonization and optimization roadmap
* Embed the enterprise\-wide HR Shared Service performance metrics into your team and drive rigorous management of measurement and continuous improvement initiatives at the regional level
* Be a change leader within your region, ensuring strong change management and transparent communications to relevant stakeholder audiences
* Support the continued maturity of the HR operating model within the region
* Build and manage the regional Shared Services team, providing feedback and coaching to drive team performance, development and engagement


**Skills Required**
* Minimum of 7 years progressive HR experience; minimum five years as a people manager and experience leading within an HR Shared Services organization in a multi\-national, matrixed environment
* Bachelor’s degree (Masters preferred) in HR, Business, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development or related field
* Associate\-centric with strong stakeholder management skills
* Strategic and analytical, capable of making data\-driven decisions and recommendations
* Continuous improvement\-oriented
* Experience working within an HR knowledgebase and case management solution and other applications, such as Workday
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities at any one time


 With annual sales of $5 billion, Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions with a proven track record of solving some of the most complex challenges we face as a society. And our Product Quality \& Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X\-Rite—protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials by tracking and authenticating the billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day. Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, with 300\+ locations worldwide.

title: Regional Head HRBP
description:
We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
   

  

 "The spending youth, especially the millennials \& Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.
   

  

 RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and appliances.
   

  

 Currently, we have 100,000\+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 12\-14 months. The current market size (as per a recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4\.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025\.
   

  

 With 700\+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US and UK. We are also profitable at monthly PAT since Oct 2021\.
   

  

 Recent Media Coverage: The Economic Times , Feb 24
   

  

**Designation: Regional Head HRBP**
**Job Summary**
 At Rent mojo our continuous endeavor is to provide excellent service to the customers. HRBP plays a pivotal role in ensuring that employees are motivated, productive and committed to serving the customers by delivering excellence. The purpose of the Regional Lead HRBP role is to partner with the Business operations team and ensure that the right people are available at the right time and at the right place. HRBP will ensure that employees are assimilated quicker in the organization and that they are committed to delivering high quality service to our customers. HRBP will also ensure we fully comply with all labor related statutory obligations consistently at every location. They operate as a single point of contact between the employees at the Site and HR team for perfect Business Delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of HRBP Executives/ Recruiter and ensure all HRBP initiatives are implemented in the assigned regions.

description:
**Job Description – HR Manager** 




  





**Kindly do not apply before reading this: We are looking for someone, having a minimum 4 years of proven experience in both end to end HR Operations and Talent Acquisition as an Individual Contributor. Proven experience in drafting HR Policies, Grievance handling, Team Management, People management, Payroll, Labor Laws, Compliance, end to end Talent Acquisition, etc is a MUST.** 




  





**Company Description** 




  





 Smart Food Safe is an innovative software company based in Bengaluru, specializing in providing state\-of\-the\-art technology solutions for businesses to excel in Quality, Food Safety, Regulatory, and Traceability management. Smart Food Safe Software offers a comprehensive suite of customizable modules designed to streamline processes, ensure regulatory compliance, enhance product quality, and enable real\-time visibility into operations.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 As the Human Resource Manager, you will play a crucial role in shaping our organizational culture, driving talent acquisition strategies, and fostering employee engagement and development. You will collaborate closely with leadership to ensure that our HR practices align with our business objectives and values.
 



  





 The Human Resource Manager will be responsible for the day\-to\-day operational and functional Human Resource activities including Talent Acquisition, Performance Management, Training \& Development, Employee Engagement, Employee Retention, Employer Branding, and HR Operations. This role will also lead the recruitment, development, and retention of tech talent critical to driving innovation and growth in the compliance technology space.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Talent Acquisition \& Hiring** 




  




* Develop and execute recruitment strategies to attract top talent across functions, including tech roles such as developers, data scientists, and QA engineers.
* Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements, candidate profiles, and interview processes.
* Source candidates through multiple channels (job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, hackathons, etc.).
* Manage end\-to\-end hiring, including screening, interviewing, offer coordination, and onboarding.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience and employer branding alignment.



  





**Talent Development \& Growth** 




  




* Design and implement training and development programs to enhance employee skills and capabilities.
* Identify skill gaps and coordinate training, mentorship, and upskilling programs.
* Design and implement career development frameworks and succession plans.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Performance Management \& Employee Relations
* Manage performance management processes and employee development initiatives.
* Handle employee relations, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions, ensuring fair and consistent practices.
* Provide guidance and support to employees on HR\-related matters, including career development and workplace policies.



  





**Employee Engagement \& Retention** 




  




* Drive employee engagement initiatives, including events, activities, surveys, and recognition programs.
* Develop retention strategies to minimize attrition and enhance employee satisfaction.
* Conduct regular check\-ins and feedback sessions to address employee concerns and foster a positive work environment.



  





**Employer Branding \& Culture Building** 




  




* Promote Smart Food Safe as an employer of choice within the tech community.
* Organize meetups, tech talks, and internal initiatives to strengthen company culture.
* Drive initiatives around collaboration, innovation, and inclusivity.



  





**HR Operations, Compliance \& Compensation** 




  




* Develop and implement HR policies and procedures in alignment with local regulations and industry best practices.
* Oversee compensation and benefits administration, including salary benchmarking, incentives, and employee welfare programs.
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, regulations, and company policies to mitigate legal risks.
* Maintain HR records, HRIS data, and prepare reports for management review.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 




  




* Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in HR and talent management and proactively recommend improvements and innovations.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Industrial Relations, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in an HR role, preferably in a software or tech\-driven environment.
* Proven experience in talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and HR operations.
* Strong understanding of Indian labor laws and regulations.
* Tech hiring exposure with understanding of software development and related roles is preferred.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Experience with Zoho HR information systems is a plus.



  





**Benefits** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Work with a talented and passionate team
* Be part of a company that is making a difference

description:
**About KPMG Delivery Network** 




  





 The world of global advisory, audit and tax compliance services for large multi\-nationals is rapidly changing and heavily dependent on technology. The KPMG Delivery Network (KDN) is a KPMG special purpose member firm offering a way for clients to leverage KPMG top talent and technology platforms through regional teams of specialists, enabling economies of scale and a new way of working that expands beyond local capability together with KDN, KPMG member firms can drive the sales and delivery of global solutions at a competitive price and in a repeatable and consistent manner.
 



  





 As a member of KDN, you’ll be a part of the KPMG family working alongside some of our profession’s most skilled practitioners on rewarding programs and initiatives that are changing the way business operates, delivering value to our clients, and driving positive change in the communities we serve.
 



 You’ll be enabling KDN accelerate new ways of working, using cutting\-edge technology and working together with our member firms located in nearly 150 countries to help us achieve our ambition to be the most trusted and trustworthy professional services firm. And through your work, you’ll build a global network and unlock opportunities that you may not have thought possible with access to great support, vast resources, and an inclusive, supportive environment to help you reach your full potential.

 As an Assistant Manager/ Consultant in Change management support the Changer Manager and team, additionally be the one in ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and effectively in end\-to\-end Change management cycle.
 



  




* Participate in client service delivery teams in the active execution of engagements, focusing on the people, technology, behavioral and cultural side of change for large\-scale transformations inclusive of org changes, process and technology
* Identify and analyze change impact, assess organizational readiness and support a change management strategy that mitigates risk and maximizes employee engagement

* Design and deliver solutions that supports organizational change; incorporating the use of behavioral change methods and frameworks and can concisely communicate ideas through PowerPoint and other forms while adjusting style and level of details depending on audience

* Conduct stakeholder identification, analysis, and segmentation, including persona mapping and impact profiling.
* Support leadership alignment journeys, including sponsor enablement, leadership action planning, and reinforcement mechanisms.

* Execute Change Impact Assessments (CIA) to assess role based, process, and technology impacts.
* Design and run business readiness assessments, adoption tracking, and go live readiness checkpoints.
* Develop and execute communication strategies and plans, including targeted messaging by stakeholder group and geography.
* Create high quality communication assets such as leadership messages, email campaigns, intranet content, videos, and go live materials.

* Assess organizational readiness and go‑live preparedness
* Develop and execute integrated change plans and Change Strategy.
* Analyze role‑based impacts across processes and systems and analyze the same.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and adoption outcomes

description:
**Company Description**
 Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment and pharmaceutical products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA.
   

  

 Group's key figures are approx. 6\.95 billion Euros turnover, over 950 laboratories across 60 countries and about 63,000 staff.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary:** 
 Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories is seeking a highly analytical and quality‑driven
 **Data Reviewer Specialist** 
 to ensure accuracy and compliance of all stability protocols and study builds prior to client release. This position plays a crucial role in safeguarding data integrity and ensuring that client expectations are consistently met.
   

  

 This role includes a structured training progression: the individual will be fully trained as a
 **Stability Protocol Writer / Study Builder** 
 prior to performing protocol and study review responsibilities. This ensures a deep understanding of both the technical content and system workflows that impact the quality of client deliveries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Training Phase – Protocol Writing \& Study Building**
* Complete comprehensive training in protocol writing based on Eurofins‑generated quotes.
* Learn and practice building stability studies within the LIMS system following client‑provided protocols.
* Develop proficiency in interpreting client requirements, scientific documentation, and stability program workflows.


**Primary Role – Data Review**
* Perform detailed, independent review of stability protocols and study builds to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with client expectations.
* Confirm that all protocol parameters (e.g., storage conditions, pull points, test plans) are correctly entered and consistent with both quotes and client\-provided documents.
* Verify compliance with GMP, internal SOPs, and industry guidelines.
* Identify discrepancies, errors, or gaps and communicate effectively with Protocol Writers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Ensure documentation is traceable, audit\-ready, and maintained in accordance with data integrity principles (ALCOA\+).
* Support continuous improvements in review workflows, documentation standards, and system utilization.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications Required:**
* Master’s degree in a scientific discipline (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field) or equivalent industry with 4\-6 years of experience.
* Experience or familiarity with GMP, data integrity expectations, and regulated laboratory environments.
* Ability to learn and work effectively within LIMS or similar informatics systems.
* Strong scientific comprehension and ability to interpret technical protocols, quotes, and study plans.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to constructively collaborate and provide clear feedback.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Key Candidate Attributes**
* Self\-motivation; excellent quality of work and attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and internal/external clients
* Ability to learn new tasks quickly and to move easily from task to task
* Ability to handle prioritization and multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to use a personal computer and learn necessary programs
* Good communication skills (oral and written)
* Organizational ability and good judgement
* Science background/education and/or laboratory experience
* Strong Math Skills
* Logical Thinking, Good Reasoning Ability
* Motivation to excel
* Coaching/mentoring of peers
